concepts.prompt:
Edit the supplied image into a new CheckLine iOS app icon concept. The supplied image is the existing Xiaoduo mascot identity reference and edit target: retain its asymmetrical rounded cloud silhouette with its two warm ivory vertical oval eyes, no mouth. Remove the detached tray and remove the previous composition. Only one mascot or one mascot-derived mark. Full-bleed opaque square canvas, no external padding, no device mockup, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no frame, no separate credit card or wallet, no money sign, no extra character, no arms or legs. The output is an individual app icon study, not a poster or contact sheet. Purpose: a memorable, uncluttered brand icon that still reads clearly as a thumbnail.
Direction 01, CLOSE PORTRAIT. A large expressive Xiaoduo cloud face fills almost the whole canvas, the bottom cloud lobe is gently cropped by the bottom edge, and the soft lobes reach near both side edges. Two large clearly spaced ivory eyes near the visual center, taking priority over surface shading. A solid warm pearl-white background with clean negative space at the upper corners. Rich clear amethyst purple cloud, restrained satin finish with just one soft tonal transition, not shiny glass. Premium editorial app branding, generous confident shapes, clean edges. No tray, no liquid line, no scattered particles, no cast shadow resembling a detached object. Make the relationship between cloud and square strikingly simple and intentional.

Direction 02, LIQUID CLOUD. The complete familiar Xiaoduo cloud silhouette is the only object, centered at around 82 percent canvas width against a very light neutral pearl background. The cloud itself is a soft translucent sculptural object, no external vessel. A single restrained, continuous liquid level lives INSIDE the cloud body below the eyes, across its lower third. The upper body is deep amethyst and the lower fill is luminous lavender, with a clean calm interface between them. Both ivory oval eyes sit clearly above the liquid boundary and remain distinct. This is one integrated cloud object, not a face hovering above a tray and not a wallet. Gentle depth, polished satin translucent material with controlled edge highlights, not plastic gloss. No bubbles, markings, particles or extra symbols. Bold recognizable single silhouette.

A solid deep purple square background, with one thick warm ivory continuous contour following the recognizable asymmetric cloud lobes; its lower contour becomes one calm nearly horizontal budget boundary before naturally reconnecting to the side lobes. The two ivory oval eyes remain inside the cloud, large enough to distinguish at small size. Preserve friendliness while making an economical, ownable symbol.
